images.caption: National Register of Historic Places Benzie County, MI

brief: A resort-town cottage lot: Frankfort Land Company house: a two-storey pale blue clapboard house with a square cupola and a wraparound porch. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: northern Michigan resort cottages of this kind are 1880-1950 buildings; Commons has almost no newer ones. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Frankfort Land Co. House (Frankfort MI, 1890), a B&B: a blue Italianate house with a balustraded belvedere cupola, bracketed eaves, shutters, a long wrap porch with spindles, a wing joined by a lattice pergola; an iron fence and a B&B sign

why.note: the Italianate belvedere, here looking over the lake
